# About me
**I'm [Sebastián](https://linkedin.com/in/romerocruzsa), a computer scientist and bioengineer from the University of Puerto Rico at Mayagüez.** I'm also co-founder of [Capicú](https://capicu.ai), a deep-tech startup building tiny AI for Biomanufacturing, removing product loss and cloud costs from the loop. <br> My previous research has been through summer stints at the University of Iowa, NVIDIA, MIT, Apple/USC, and more. During my final undergrad years, I worked under [Dr. Wilfredo Lugo Beauchamp](https://linkedin.com/in/wilfredo-lugo-beauchamp-0b083838) in applied Edge AI for remote smart health & computer vision applications. My graduate research, under advisement of [Dr. Maribella Domenech](https://linkedin.com/in/maribella-domenech-7ab17526), has been studying how mechanical cues affect extracellular vesicle (EV) production and what proteins in the EV surface can be leveraged for targeted cell therapies.
